### 📄 Print Copy of the Phytosanitary Certificate

The certificate's details have been laid out for the pre-printed Phytosanitary Certificate form. Next, print it on the form, sign it, and upload the signed certificate.

#### [📄 Download Print Copy](files:{{.print_copy.key}})

Open it, load the pre-printed form in the printer, and print it at 100% scale with the browser's headers and footers turned off.
